freq_pairs.question: An itemset is frequent when its support is at least 1 percent. Return how many 2-itemsets meet that threshold. Do not count single items.

cases.input: Several pairs meet a 1 percent support threshold and single items do too.
cases.expect: The count is the frequent 2-itemsets, not the 1-itemsets.

rv_confidence.question: Among baskets that contain root vegetables, what fraction also contain whole milk? Return the confidence of root vegetables to whole milk, not the lift and not the reverse rule.

cases.input: Seven of ten baskets with root vegetables also have whole milk.
cases.expect: The result is the confidence of root vegetables to whole milk, not the lift and not the reverse rule.

cases.input: Root vegetables never appear with whole milk.

tf_lift.question: Compare how often tropical fruit and pip fruit appear together with how often they would if they were independent. Return the lift of tropical fruit to pip fruit.

cases.input: Tropical fruit and pip fruit occur together more often than if they were independent.
cases.expect: The result is the lift of that rule, and it is above 1.
